description: One tiny isolated burst of electrical sparks centered at x12 y12. Four very short angular one-pixel white-cream and muted amber strokes with a tiny central spark, sparse and irregular. Full burst inside a 24x24 canvas with transparent margins. No equipment, cable, light halo or background. Strict native one-pixel-grid pixel art for DREAMS, a dark abandoned fast-food restaurant at 320x180 native resolution. Effect only, transparent background, hard opaque pixel clusters, limited supplied palette. No anti-aliasing, gradients, dithering, blur, glow, drawn background lighting, characters, text, furniture or other objects. Static camera and fixed canvas; no zoom or global position/scale jitter. Canvas exactly 24x24 pixels.

reference_images.usage_description: Native pixel density and flat pixel rendering only. Create the requested different VFX, not this steam shape.
